title: Knowledge-Based Mechanisms
abstract: arXiv:2609.03439v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study robust mechanisms when the designer possesses a Bayesian belief over some components of agents' private information but faces ambiguity over others. The designer evaluates mechanisms by their worst-case performance over all joint distributions consistent with her belief over the Bayesian components. The framework encompasses settings such as multidimensional delegation in which a principal knows the distribution of the state but not the agent's preferences (e.g., his tradeoffs across dimensions), screening in which a seller only has misspecified estimates of buyer preferences, and auction and voting design when agents' beliefs about each other are ambiguous to the designer. We provide conditions under which a \emph{knowledge-based} mechanism---one that conditions only on the Bayesian components but not the ambiguous ones---is robustly optimal. translated_abstract: 我们研究了当设计者对智能体私人信息的某些成分持有贝叶斯信念、但对其他成分面临模糊性时的稳健机制设计问题。设计者通过机制在所有与其贝叶斯成分信念相一致的联合分布下的最坏情况表现来评估机制。该框架涵盖了多种情境，例如：多维委托问题中，委托人知道状态的分布但不了解智能体的偏好（例如其在各维度之间的权衡取舍）；筛选问题中，卖方对买方偏好的估计存在错误设定；以及当智能体彼此之间的信念对设计者而言是模糊时的拍卖与投票设计。我们给出了在何种条件下，“基于知识的机制”——即仅以贝叶斯成分为条件、而不以模糊成分为条件的机制——是稳健最优的。我们的结果统一了以往在不同经济环境中得到的研究成果，并揭示了新的……
tldr: 本文研究了设计者对部分私人信息持贝叶斯信念而对其余部分面临模糊性时的稳健机制设计，并给出了仅依赖已知贝叶斯成分的“基于知识的机制”为稳健最优的条件。
en_tdlr: This paper studies robust mechanism design when the designer holds Bayesian beliefs over some components of private information but faces ambiguity over others, providing conditions under which knowledge-based mechanisms—conditioning only on the Bayesian components—are robustly optimal.
